description: The offers ranked for an intent from find_offers, best first, only those that fit, each with its tracked link (tracked_url) and how_to_buy. offer_id is the offer's public ID: lst_ for a merchant listing (open tracked_url to book with the merchant, no sign-in), off_ for a seller's offer on Arugula. By using Arugula you agree to arugulanet.com/terms. Privacy: arugulanet.com/privacy.

brief.description: true for a short answer: each offer's title, price, fit, how to buy and tracked link, without the explanations.
